scope.externalSpanScope: Only evidence IDs referenced by the main/project review JSON; unused external catalog spans were not validated.

limitations: No new AST parse was performed: function/call syntax classifications are inherited facts, while identity, exact byte spans, hashes and references were checked independently.
A route journal without an explicit expected pin is actual-hash-only, even when all referenced source spans match.
Historical RWC indirect input pin failures are separate from the nine new module identities, direct artifact pins, fresh spans and reference errors.
No product-mode, runtime reachability or exclusion inference is made.
